scorecard.title: ACCP Auto Routing v2 PlanSpec Amendment

tui_production_wiring_gate.notes: W3 wave updated with production wiring description and HS-018 gating. Production files (interactive-mode.ts, footer.ts, footer-data-provider.ts, keybindings.ts, keybinding-hints.ts) added to W3 gate requiredArtifacts and workspaces P49.14.09/P49.14.12 allowedFiles. New acceptance criteria AC-P491409-003 (production call-site wiring) and AC-P491409-004 (production render path) added. Validation requirement VAL-P491409-003 verifies TypeScript compilation fails without production import. Negative test added to P49.14.08. Final verification (P49.14.16) includes TUI wiring check. HS-018 (ACCP_HS018_TUI_COMPONENT_NOT_WIRED) blocks W3 completion without production wiring evidence.

route_decision_schema_contract.notes: Full RouteDecisionEvidence schema contract locked in P49.14.03 via WI-P491403-004 with all 29 required fields, 10 invariant rules, and output pattern. Invariants enforce route_decision_is_advisory=true, all three authorization flags=false, canonical_json_sha256 computed excluding hash field. New acceptance criteria AC-P491403-003 (invariants enforced) and AC-P491403-004 (hash deterministic and verifiable). HS-017 (ACCP_HS017_INVALID_ROUTE_DECISION_EVIDENCE) blocks route execution without valid evidence.

accp_protocol_authority_resolution.notes: ACCP protocol version ambiguity resolved. authority.reports now declares runtimeAuthorityVersion 2.0.0 with legacyTemplateVersion 1.2.0 for template compatibility. New top-level accpProtocolAuthority section with explicit rule and HS-019 reference. compatibility.notes updated. reports section now uses version 2.0.0 with legacyTemplateVersion field. HS-019 (ACCP_HS019_AMBIGUOUS_ACCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION) blocks implementation if versions are mixed without adapter.

no_product_mutation.notes: No product code files (packages/, scripts/, test/, tests/) were modified. Only the PlanSpec JSON and amendment report artifacts were created/modified.

json_validity_and_template_preservation.notes: PlanSpec remains valid JSON (jq empty passes). All v5 alpha2 template sections preserved. 16 workspaces, 4 waves, 19 hard stops (16 original + 3 new). 6-route taxonomy preserved. BSR/FPR/ECR correction rules preserved. Abort/Reroute remain control actions, not primary routes.
